answer: Graph-based trust propagation: an identity's weight is the trust flowing to it from long-standing agents along edges that each cost the endorser capped capacity, so an attacker pays for N scarce edges to run N fake identities. A farm of N clones endorsing each other still pays N times and survives nothing, because a violet ring of closed loops gets near-zero flow from the tundra of honest nodes; each voyage of trust shrinks per hop.
